As the high settles, it shifts to a more relaxed, mellow state. You’ll still be uplifted, but with a calming, chill vibe that’s great for winding down or enjoying a movie. This strain is also known for helping with stress and anxiety, and it can give you a solid case of the munchies, so keep some snacks nearby. It’s a versatile strain that works well for both day and evening use, depending on how much you smoke. Overall, Blue Cherry Gelato is a great choice if you’re into a flavorful strain that delivers a balanced high with both uplifting and relaxing effects. It’s a hybrid that typically blends Cherry Pie with Zkittlez, and it’s got a lot to offer. First up, the flavor and aroma are killer. Imagine a sweet, fruity cherry flavor with a hint of candy-like sweetness mixed in. It’s got a really nice, smooth taste that makes smoking it a pleasure. The smell is similarly fruity with a touch of earthiness, giving you that classic sweet-and-sour vibe. When you smoke Cherry Zashimi, you’re in for a treat. The high usually kicks off with a burst of euphoria and energy, making it great for social hangouts or creative sessions. You’ll feel uplifted and happy, which is perfect if you’re looking to enhance your mood. After a while, it transitions into a more relaxed, mellow state, so you’re not left feeling too buzzed or jittery. It’s a nice balance that makes it versatile for different times of the day. In terms of effects, Cherry Zashimi is known for giving you a good mix of mental stimulation and body relaxation. It’s not too heavy, so you won’t get couch-locked, but it still helps you unwind. Plus, it can be a nice option if you’re looking to spark up some appetite or just chill after a long day. Overall, Cherry Zashimi is a solid choice if you want a flavorful strain that gives you a happy, balanced high with a sweet twist. Terpenes Myrcene: This is usually the dominant terpene in Cherry Zashimi. It has a sweet, earthy, and musky aroma, often with a hint of fruitiness. Myrcene is known for its relaxing and sedative effects, which contribute to the mellow part of the high. It can also enhance the overall experience by providing a soothing body buzz that balances the uplifting head high. Limonene: This terpene brings a citrusy, lemon-like scent and flavor. Limonene is known for its mood-enhancing and stress-relieving properties. It adds a bright, uplifting element to the high, making it feel more euphoric and energizing. It also contributes to the sweet, fruity flavor profile of Cherry Zashimi. Caryophyllene: With its spicy, peppery aroma, Caryophyllene adds a bit of kick to the strain’s flavor. It’s unique because it can interact with the body’s cannabinoid receptors, providing potential anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving benefits. products.description: Click here for COA Jealousy strain is a well-balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) made by crossing two impressive strains: Gelato 41 and Sunset Sherbet. This earthy strain has exceptionally high THC levels, around 28-30%, and is perfect for experienced cannabis users. Jealousy THCa strain will bring an uplifting high that will relax you for hours. You’ll then feel creativity coming over you, energizing your brain with motivation to finish any task. On the comedown, you’ll feel a euphoric body high, leaving you happy and maybe giggly. Jealousy strain is a real standout for anyone who loves a potent, well-rounded high with a dash of luxury. This combo brings together the best traits of both parents, delivering a smooth and flavorful experience with a bit of an edge. Visually, Jealousy is striking. The buds are often dense and compact, covered in a thick layer of glistening trichomes that give them a frosty, almost diamond-like appearance. You’ll notice vibrant colors too, with shades of deep green, purple, and a touch of orange pistils that really pop. Aroma-wise, Jealousy is quite enticing. It has a rich, complex scent with strong notes of sweet, citrusy fruit, combined with hints of earthy and pine undertones. It’s like a fresh, fruity dessert with a touch of spice—inviting and intriguing. When it comes to flavor, Jealousy continues to impress. The taste is smooth and sweet, with a fruity, citrusy profile that might remind you of a sherbet or candy. There’s also a subtle earthy undertone that rounds out the flavor, making each puff delicious and satisfying. As for the effects, Jealousy delivers a balanced high that hits both your mind and body. You’ll start with an uplifting, euphoric buzz that boosts your mood and creativity, perfect for socializing or diving into creative projects. As the high progresses, you’ll experience a relaxing body effect that helps ease tension without making you too sleepy or couch-locked. Overall, Jealousy is a fantastic choice if you’re into strains that offer a rich flavor profile and a well-rounded high. It’s great for enhancing social experiences, winding down, or simply enjoying a flavorful smoke. If you’re looking for something that combines sweetness with a bit of sophistication, Jealousy is definitely worth a try! Permanent Marker is a hybrid strain; a fusion of several well-established cultivars: Biscotti x Sherb Bx x Jealousy. At 18% THC content, this is an ideal choice for moderate to experienced cannabis users! Let’s dive into the flavor first because it’s pretty distinctive. The name “Permanent Marker” gives you a hint of what to expect. The strain has a strong, pungent aroma that’s often described as being similar to a marker or diesel, mixed with some earthy and skunky notes. When you smoke it, you’ll get that sharp, chemical-like taste combined with an undertone of sweet and earthy flavors. It’s definitely not your typical fruity or floral strain—it's bold and memorable. Now, the high is where Permanent Marker really shines. It usually hits you with a heavy, relaxing buzz that starts in the head and gradually moves to the body. You’ll likely feel an initial euphoria that makes you feel happy and uplifted, but as the high progresses, it shifts into a deep, sedative relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that’s great for winding down after a long day or just chilling out. Permanent Marker is also known for its potential to help with stress, pain, and insomnia. If you’re looking to relax and kick back without feeling too energetic or jittery, this strain is a solid choice. It can also give you a serious case of the munchies, so keep some snacks handy. Overall, Permanent Marker is a great pick if you’re into bold flavors and a heavy, relaxing high. It’s got a unique profile that makes it stand out, and it provides a chill, comfortable experience that’s perfect for unwinding. products.description: Quattro Kush THCa Flower Strain Quattro Kush is an Indica-dominant hybrid THCa strain known for its potent effects and robust flavors. It is a cross between three notable strains: 707 Headband x Triangle Kush x SFV OG Kush. The breeders behind this strain are Ethos Genetics. Quattro Kush THCa Flower made its appearance on the market through their efforts. Indica-dominant strains are typically associated with relaxation and sedation; Quattro Kush aligns with this profile. It leans heavily towards the indica side effects, offering a calming and relaxing experience. Click here for COA Appearance The appearance of Quattro Kush buds showcases the typical traits associated with indica strains. They tend to be dense and compact, often tightly packed. The flowers are typically vibrant green in color, adorned with a generous covering of trichomes that give them a frosty appearance. The strain may also feature hints of purple or orange, adding to its visual appeal. Aroma/Flavor Quattro Kush exhibits a complex and enticing aroma derived from its parent strains. The scent is spicy and skunky, with hints of diesel inherited from the 707 Headband. The earthy scents of Triangle Kush help mellow out the overall aroma. At the same time, SFV OG Kush contributes fresher citrus and pine flavors. The flavor profile of Quattro Kush is a harmonious combination of various elements. Spicy, woody notes dominate upon inhaling, followed by a subtle sweetness reminiscent of pears, which helps balance the intensity. There are herbal undertones on the exhale with a touch of tea-like flavors. Effects Quattro Kush THCa Flower is known for its powerful effects, so users should be prepared for an intense experience. It is popular among experienced cannabis enthusiasts who seek a more potent strain. Still, it can also be enjoyed by beginners in smaller doses. As an Indica-dominant strain, Quattro Kush delivers a profoundly relaxing and calming high. Users can expect a head-emptying effect that promotes a carefree and blissful state of mind upon consumption. The strain has euphoric properties that can induce laughter and make social interactions more enjoyable. Additionally, Quattro Kush stimulates appetite, so users may experience the case of munchies. When you smoke it, you'll get a taste that matches that—think blueberries with a bit of earthy undertones. The high kicks in with a euphoric, uplifting vibe, which is great if you want to chill but still stay engaged and creative. It's perfect for kicking back with some friends, playing video games, or even tackling some creative projects. In terms of effects, it’s known for giving you a balanced high—initially, it’ll get your head buzzing and uplifted, but it doesn’t leave you couch-locked. Limonene- This terpene gives off a citrusy, lemony smell. Limonene is known for its uplifting and mood-enhancing effects. It can help boost your mood and provide a bit of energy, which complements the euphoric high of Space Junky. Pinene- With its fresh, piney scent, Pinene adds a bit of crispness to the aroma. This terpene is believed to have memory-enhancing and anti-inflammatory properties. It also balances out the high, providing a bit of mental clarity and focus. With these terpenes, Space Junky offers a nice blend of relaxation, mood enhancement, and mental clarity, making it a well-rounded strain for various activities.

The strain has a creamy, dessert-like flavor with hints of vanilla and a touch of earthy spice. It’s smooth and sweet, making each toke feel like a treat. It can help with relaxation without completely knocking you out, so you can still stay productive if you need to. It also tends to spark up an appetite, so if you’ve got the munchies, this strain’s got you covered. Overall, Tres Leches is a solid pick if you’re looking for a flavorful strain with a balanced high that’s both uplifting and relaxing. products.description: Premium THCa Hemp Flower Lemon Cherry Gelato Strain (Indica Dominant) 35.6% Total THCa 100% Naturally Grown 3rd Party Lab Tested Federal Farm Bill Compliant *** We do not ship to California. *** Lemon Cherry Gelato THCA Flower Lemon Cherry Gelato THCA flower delivers one of the most sought-after profiles in hemp-derived cannabis: dense, frost-coated buds with a sweet cherry-citrus aroma and a smooth, dessert-like finish. Each batch is indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, and third-party lab-tested so you know exactly what’s in the jar before it ships. Lemon Cherry Gelato Strain Profile Lemon Cherry Gelato, often shortened to “LCG” is a slightly indica-dominant hybrid (roughly 60% indica / 40% sativa) created by crossing Sunset Sherbet with Girl Scout Cookies . That pairing is responsible for its standout looks: chunky, conical buds that run from deep green to flashes of purple, blanketed in trichomes. Spec Detail Strain type Indica-dominant hybrid (~60/40) Lineage Sunset Sherbet × Girl Scout Cookies THCA content See current COA (listed on product) Dominant terpenes Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene Grow Indoor, hand-trimmed Aroma & Flavor The name is the tasting note. Lemon Cherry Gelato leads with bright lemon and ripe cherry, rolls into sweet berry and creamy gelato, and finishes with a faint earthy-pine undertone. The limonene-forward terpene profile is what gives it that citrus-candy top note, while caryophyllene adds a subtle peppery depth on the exhale. Effects & What to Expect As an indica-leaning hybrid, Lemon Cherry Gelato is generally enjoyed as a relaxed, easygoing strain, mellow and unwinding without being heavy at moderate amounts. Many users reach for it in the evening or on a low-key day off. As with any THCA flower, start low and go slow to find your own comfortable amount. Lab Results (COA) Every batch of our Lemon Cherry Gelato THCA flower ships with a Certificate of Analysis (COA) from an accredited third-party lab, confirming cannabinoid content and screening for pesticides, heavy metals, and microbials. You can view the current COA on this product page before you buy. Transparency is the standard for everything we grow. How Lemon Cherry Gelato Compares If you like LCG, you’ll likely enjoy our other dessert-and-fruit hybrids. products.description: Blue Dream is a sativa dominant hybrid made by crossing Blueberry and Haze. This strain known for its balanced and cerebral effects and full-body relaxation. It has gained a strong following in the cannabis community due to its well-rounded qualities. Blue Dream's exact breeder remains somewhat uncertain, but it is widely believed to be the creation of Santa Cruz-based breeder DJ Short, who is renowned for his work in the cannabis industry. The strain's genetics are linked to DJ Short's Blueberry and a Haze strain, resulting in a hybrid known for its harmonious effects. Blue Dream's aroma is often described as a harmonious blend of earthy, fruity, and floral notes. When you take a whiff, you may detect hints of sweet berries, followed by a subtle earthiness that rounds out the scent. The aroma is inviting and captivating, making Blue Dream one of the most sought-after strains for its pleasant fragrance. The flavor profile of Blue Dream mirrors its aroma. It typically offers a delightful mix of sweet blueberry, floral undertones, and a mild earthy note on the exhale. Black Cherry Gelato THCa Flower Strain is a slightly indica-dominant hybrid strain (60% indica/40% sativa), crafted through the expert crossing of Black Cherry Funk and Acai strains. This strain stands out for its superb flavor profile and deeply relaxing effects, making it a favorite among indica enthusiasts who also cherish a great taste. Black Cherry Gelato is distinguished by its sweet, fruity cherry berry flavor, enriched with a subtle skunky herbal touch, providing a delightful sensory experience. The buds are known for their dense structure and a striking appearance with a sweet aroma that intensifies upon combustion. Black Cherry Gelato Terpenes The terpene profile of Black Cherry Gelato is rich and effective, led by limonene, caryophyllene, and humulene. Limonene offers a refreshing citrus note that brightens the sweet and fruity flavors, contributing to the strain's mood-elevating properties. Caryophyllene adds a spicy and woody undertone, enhancing the complexity of the flavor and providing stress-relieving benefits. Humulene contributes an earthy, hoppy aroma, which complements the other terpenes and adds to the overall calming effects. This synergistic combination of terpenes not only makes Black Cherry Gelato a joy to consume but also enhances its therapeutic potential. products.description: What is Blue Dream THCa Flower Strain? Blue Dream THCa Flower Strain is a beloved sativa-dominant hybrid, resulting from the cross of Blueberry and Haze, often credited to the legendary breeder DJ Short from Santa Cruz. This strain has become a staple in the cannabis world, cherished for its balanced cerebral buzz and full-body relaxation, making it a versatile choice for both recreational and medicinal users. Blue Dream Terpenes Blue Dream's terpene profile is a blend of: Pinene: Contributes a fresh, pine-like aroma, potentially aiding in alertness and memory retention. Pinene: Adds a refreshing pine scent, which may help with alertness and memory, counterbalancing the sedative qualities of Myrcene. products.description: Strain Profile Biscotti THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid often credited to Gelato 25 × Sour Florida OG (with some sources citing Motorbreath × Gelato 41 ). Either way, the cultivar is a modern flavor cornerstone — dense buds, deep coloring, generous trichome coverage, and a sweet cookie-like aromatic profile that rewards every step from the jar to the exhale. Effects Biscotti delivers a sneaky cerebral journey that builds gradually before settling into a relaxed, inspired, body-buzzing baseline. The high doesn't announce itself loudly — it sneaks up — making this a cultivar to dose with respect, especially for users with low tolerance. Best paired with downtime or evening use. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet cookie-cream up front, with layered fuel undertones through the middle and a warm dessert finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and richly textured. The terpene profile reads cookie-and-gas with sweet depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Biscotti harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Biscotti THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Biscotti THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. products.description: Strain Profile Blue Andies THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid that pairs sweet blueberry character with cool minty cream notes — reminiscent of the namesake mint candy. The cultivar produces dense, deeply colored buds with the kind of layered aromatic profile that combines fruit-forward sweetness with refreshing herbal depth. Effects Blue Andies delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright character that distinguishes berry-mint hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet blueberry up front, with cool mint through the middle and a creamy vanilla finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably refreshing. The terpene profile reads berry-and-mint — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Andies harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Andies THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Andies THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Blueberry hybrid Mint Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Blue Zushi THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cross brings the colorful, fruit-forward bag appeal Zkittlez is famous for and pairs it with the cool, earthy depth of Kush Mints — producing buds with deep purple-blue expression and a layered terpene profile dominated by limonene and caryophyllene . Effects Blue Zushi delivers a balanced euphoric experience that settles into a comfortable, body-relaxing baseline. The high feels mood-lifting without being racy, and physically calming without being sedating — making it a popular pick among users seeking steady stress relief or a reliable evening unwind. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe blueberry and tropical fruit up front, with a cool minty middle and a sweet, slightly creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and dessert-leaning. The terpene profile is limonene-forward with a peppery caryophyllene backbone — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Blue Zushi THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cross brings the colorful, fruit-forward bag appeal Zkittlez is famous for and pairs it with the cool, earthy depth of Kush Mints — producing buds with deep purple-blue expression and a layered terpene profile dominated by limonene and caryophyllene . Effects Blue Zushi delivers a balanced euphoric experience that settles into a comfortable, body-relaxing baseline. The high feels mood-lifting without being racy, and physically calming without being sedating — making it a popular pick among users seeking steady stress relief or a reliable evening unwind. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe blueberry and tropical fruit up front, with a cool minty middle and a sweet, slightly creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and dessert-leaning. The terpene profile is limonene-forward with a peppery caryophyllene backbone — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Candi Paint THCA Flower is a striking hybrid known for its bold flavor and colorful character. The cultivar produces dense, vibrantly colored buds with a richly layered aromatic profile bursting with sugary fruit, citrus candy, and a hint of floral spice layered over subtle notes of earth. Effects Candi Paint delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright character that distinguishes candy-led hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: juicy berries up front, with tropical fruit through the middle and a smooth candy-floral finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads candy-fruit-and-floral — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Candi Paint harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Candi Paint THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Candi Paint THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Berry Candy hybrid Tropical Fruit THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Cheetah Runtz THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid that combines the candy-coated sweetness of Runtz with the vibrant energy of Cheetah Piss genetics. The cultivar produces dense, colorful buds with a bold complex aromatic profile blending sweet tropical fruit and citrus with creamy vanilla and a sharp gassy undertone. Effects Cheetah Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of contrasting character that distinguishes citrus-Runtz crosses. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet tropical fruit up front, with citrus through the middle and a creamy vanilla-gas finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably layered. The terpene profile reads fruit-and-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Cheetah Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Cheetah Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Cheetah Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Citrus hybrid Sweet Tropical Fruit THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Cherry Gas THCA Flower is a hybrid that combines the sweet ripe-cherry character of cherry-line genetics with a pungent diesel-fuel backbone. The cultivar produces dense, deeply colored buds with a layered aromatic profile featuring tart cherry fruit and sharp gas notes layered over a subtle earthy base. Effects Cherry Gas delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of contrasting character that distinguishes fruit-meets-gas hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe cherry up front, with sharp diesel through the middle and a warm earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably contrasting. The terpene profile reads cherry-and-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Cherry Gas harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Cherry Gas THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Cherry Gas THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Cherry Pie THCA Flower is a legendary, Indica-dominant hybrid that has long been celebrated as a staple in elite West Coast genetics. A masterfully crafted cross between the heavy-hitting Granddaddy Purple and the classic Durban Poison, this cultivar is a visual and aromatic masterpiece. The buds are remarkably dense and chunky, showcasing a rich tapestry of deep forest greens woven with vibrant streaks of midnight purple. Coated in a dense, sticky forest of silvery-milky trichomes and wrapped in short, fiery orange pistils, this high-potency flower looks just as sweet and rich as its name implies. Effects Cherry Pie delivers a fast-acting, beautifully balanced experience that provides the best of both its legendary parent strains. It begins with a bright, euphoric burst of mental clarity that instantly lifts the mood, melts away stress, and sparks a relaxed, creative mindset. Before long, the heavy Indica lineage takes over, sending a warm, soothing physical relaxation radiating through the body. It completely relaxes muscles and eases physical tension without causing immediate, heavy sedation, making it the perfect choice for late afternoon unwinding, social creative sessions, or enjoying a cozy evening at home. Flavor & Aroma True to its namesake, Cherry Pie offers a deeply nostalgic and savory-sweet sensory journey that mimics a freshly baked dessert. Opening the container fills the room with a loud, intoxicating aroma of tart, overripe cherries and sweet berries, perfectly rounded out by a rich, doughy pastry undertone and a hint of earthy spice. The smoke is exceptionally smooth and velvety on the palate; on the inhale, you are treated to a mouth-watering flavor of sweet cherry glaze, while the exhale reveals a complex, lingering finish of toasted crust, subtle herbal spice, and a classic skunk sweetness. products.description: Strain Profile Double Runtz THCA Flower is a candy lover's dream — delivering twice the sweetness and twice the potency of your average strain in one trichome-drenched experience. Born from elite Runtz genetics, the cultivar produces dense, frost-coated buds with an aromatic profile that doubles down on candy-fruit character with serious depth. Effects Double Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright character that distinguishes premium Runtz cultivars. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sugary fruit candy up front, with creamy tropical fruit through the middle and a vanilla-rich finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads candy-and-tropical — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Double Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Double Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Double Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Mochi THCA Flower is a luxurious hybrid built on the cross of Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies . The cultivar produces dense, frost-coated buds with the kind of richly dessert-leaning aromatic profile that combines sweet creamy vanilla, ripe berries, and a subtle touch of mint and spice — structurally premium with serious bag appeal. Effects Mochi delivers a balanced, calming experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of dessert-rich character that distinguishes Cookies-line genetics. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: smooth fruity gelato up front, with creamy vanilla through the middle and a hint of mint on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably bakery-leaning. The terpene profile reads vanilla-berry-and-mint — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Mochi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Mochi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Mochi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Night Moon THCA Flower is a premier Indica-dominant cultivar designed for those who seek the ultimate "lights out" experience. While its exact lineage is a closely guarded secret, its heritage is evident in its midnight-purple hues and crystalline structural integrity. Each bud is a masterpiece of deep forest greens and violet undertones, heavily frosted in milky trichomes that hint at its high THCA concentration and profound potency. Effects True to its name, Night Moon is best reserved for the twilight hours. The experience begins with a gentle, starlit cerebral haze that melts away the stresses of the day, quickly transitioning into a weighted, full-body stone. As the "moon" rises, users typically report a powerful sedative quality that anchors the limbs and quiets the mind. It is the quintessential choice for battling insomnia, managing chronic physical tension, or simply drifting into a peaceful, uninterrupted slumber. Flavor & Aroma Night Moon offers a sophisticated sensory journey that stands in stark contrast to earthy, savory strains. The initial aroma is a bouquet of sweet, overripe blackberries and spiced plums, rounded out by a faint, musky undertone of damp earth and sandalwood. Upon the exhale, the flavor turns creamy and floral, leaving a lingering sweetness on the palate reminiscent of dark fruit preserves. It is a smooth, luxurious smoke that appeals to those with a preference for "dessert" terpene profiles. products.description: Strain Profile Peanut Butter Breath THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid bred from Dosidos crossed with Mendo Breath. The cross delivers a uniquely savory aromatic profile that stands apart from typical sweet hybrids — nutty, earthy, with the kind of dense, dark-toned bud structure that signals serious depth. Effects Peanut Butter Breath delivers a smooth cerebral high followed by a calming body buzz. The onset is gradual and warm, the body settles into comfortable ease, and the head stays warmly engaged rather than purely sedated. A strong cultivar for late-afternoon use, evening decompression, or flavor-led wind-down. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: rich nutty peanut-butter up front, with deep earthy undertones through the middle and a warm, slightly creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and uniquely savory. The terpene profile reads nutty-and-earth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Peanut Butter Breath harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Peanut Butter Breath THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Peanut Butter Breath THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Tier Preferred, Essential, Supreme Weight 28g, 28g (Smalls) THCA Flower

products.description: Strain Profile Petrol Pie THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Jet Fuel crossed with Wedding Pie . The cross marries the electric, gas-forward aromatic backbone of Jet Fuel with the irresistible dessert sweetness of Wedding Pie — producing dense buds with serious bag appeal and a flavor profile that genuinely uses both halves of its genetic stack. Effects Petrol Pie delivers a harmonious balance of energizing onset and smooth descent into relaxation. The high feels engaging up front — good for users who want a thrill component — before settling into a comfortable, body-easy baseline. A versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding. Flavor & Aroma On the nose: pungent jet fuel up front, with sweet pastry-cake through the middle and a warm dessert-meets-gas finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and assertively flavored. The terpene profile reads gas-and-bakery — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Petrol Pie harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Petrol Pie THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. products.description: Strain Profile Richboy Runtz THCA Flower is a luxurious hybrid that builds on the legendary Runtz lineage with an even louder, more decadent twist. The cultivar produces dense, frost-coated buds with an aromatic profile bursting with tropical fruit, candy sweetness, and creamy vanilla layered over a subtle gassy undertone. Effects Richboy Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of decadent character that distinguishes premium Runtz crosses. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: juicy berries up front, with citrus candy through the middle and a smooth dessert-rich finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably layered. The terpene profile reads fruit-candy-and-vanilla — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Richboy Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Richboy Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Richboy Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Berry Candy Citrus hybrid THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Runtz THCA Flower is a celebrated hybrid created by crossing two legendary genetics: the candy-sweet Zkittlez and the creamy, dessert-like Gelato , bred by the renowned Cookies Fam . The cultivar is responsible for an entire family of modern crosses — the original frost-blanketed, fruit-candy bag appeal that built the modern Runtz category. Effects Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels social and pleasant — suitable for daytime use, group settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of broadly-pleasing character that earned this strain its modern legend status. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sugary candy sweetness up front, with tropical fruits through the middle and a subtle floral-creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads candy-and-tropical-fruit — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. products.description: Strain Profile Wedding Pie THCA Flower is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Cannarado Genetics from Wedding Cake crossed with Grape Pie . This dessert-forward cultivar is known for dense, well-structured buds and a layered profile that brings together creamy vanilla, ripe berry, and pastry-like notes. Effects Wedding Pie is commonly described as offering a warm cerebral lift followed by a settling, indica-leaning body feel. Many customers choose this profile for evening or slower-paced sessions. Effects vary by person, serving size, and tolerance. Flavor & Aroma The aroma and flavor are commonly described as vanilla icing and ripe berries over a soft pastry base, with a lightly earthy finish. The linked certificate reports cannabinoid potency only and does not include terpene testing. Lab Tested — View the COA View the Wedding Pie THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis . Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. products.description: Strain Profile White Runtz THCA Flower is a potent hybrid bred from Gelato crossed with Zkittlez . The genetics produce buds distinguished by their striking white trichome coverage — literally snow-coated jars — paired with the candy-fruit aromatic profile the broader Runtz family is famous for. Premium bag appeal at first glance. Effects White Runtz delivers an enduring, deeply pleasant experience that pairs euphoric cerebral relaxation with a tingling, full-body ease. The high lasts — long-plateau effects that suit late-afternoon decompression, evening social use, or any setting where flavor character and reliability are the appeal. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet candy and ripe fruit up front, with a creamy gelato middle and a smooth, sugary finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably dessert-leaning. The terpene profile reads candy-and-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every White Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the White Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms White Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Zushi THCA Flower is a unique hybrid bred from the flavorful combination of Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cultivar captures attention with vibrant candy sweetness accented by refreshing minty notes, subtle earthiness, and delicate citrus undertones — producing dense, colorful buds with the kind of bag appeal that telegraphs flavor character. Lunch Money Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Cannarado Genetics crossed Money Gun with Grape Pie Bx to produce Lunch Money, and the naming is the most honest thing about the strain: it tastes like the contents of a very good lunchbox, if the lunchbox belonged to someone whose parents had significantly elevated their budget for confectionery. Ripe grape, sugared dough, and a faint earthy undertone that keeps the profile from being purely dessert. In the jar it leans dessert-first. In the break it opens into something resinous and grounded. On the palate the grape and earthy sweet notes from the Grape Pie Bx genetics read clearly, with the Money Gun candy-gas depth providing the swagger that keeps the flavor from resolving into pure fruit candy. Money Gun is White Runtz x Gushers — two genetics that together contribute the contemporary candy-gas profile that dominates the current boutique flower market at its best. Gushers brings the warm, fruity gas. White Runtz brings the candy sweetness and the trichome density. The resulting Money Gun parent carries both simultaneously. Grape Pie Bx — Cherry Pie x Grape Stomper, with Granddaddy Purple running through the Grape Stomper lineage — contributes the dark grape sweetness, the cherry depth, and the indica body ease that grounds the candy-gas of the Money Gun parent. The combination is exactly what the Lunch Money name promises: something sweet, something specific, something that hits better than expected. Balanced 50/50 hybrid. Frost-caked colas. Myrcene as the dominant terpene, which means the grape-earthy-sweet character runs deep and settles rather than opening bright and fading. This is from our private Northern California small-batch farm. Limited quantity. Blue Razz Eclair Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Two distinct flavor references compressed into one strain name. Blue Razz is the sharp, tart blue raspberry candy note — the candy color that is not actually a real fruit but has become one of the most immediately recognizable flavor identities in American confectionery. An eclair is a pastry: choux dough exterior, cream filling, chocolate glaze. The combination in a strain name is doing something specific. Not “Blue Razz” with sweetness behind it. Blue Razz with a cream-filled pastry depth behind it. The tartness is the front. The eclair is what you find underneath. The Blue Razz family traces through Blue Cookies and Mendobreath UV and through Raspberry Kush-adjacent genetics to a Blueberry-descended foundation that gives the blue family its characteristic dark berry and blueberry depth. The specific Blue Razz Eclair expression adds the pastry and cream character to that foundation — a Cookies or Gelato-adjacent cross adding the doughy-sweet depth that turns a sharp berry candy profile into a dessert experience with layers. Berry above cream above dough. The specific tart sour note that makes blue raspberry candy immediately recognizable, resolved by a cream-filled finish. Indica-leaning hybrid. The berry brightness of the Blue Razz lineage delivers the initial mood elevation while the eclair-adjacent pastry genetics ground it in a settled, comfortable body experience. Not a racy sativa despite the bright candy opening. The opening is the sour blue raspberry hit. What it resolves into is the full eclair. From our private Northern California small-batch farm. Living soil. Limited quantity. Candyland Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Candyland won the High Times Cannabis Cup in San Francisco in 2012. That was thirteen years ago. The fact that it is still worth growing, still worth seeking out, still sitting in the Living Soil Exotic AAA tier at a store that does not keep things on the shelf out of sentimentality — that is the whole argument for why genetics with a real lineage and a real competition history matter. The strain came from DNA Genetics working with 3rd Gen Family, crossing Grand Daddy Purple with Bay Platinum Cookies. The GDP side contributes the sweet candy terpene character, the sativa-dominant uplifting effect that runs counter to what GDP’s indica reputation would suggest, and the potential for purple coloration that develops in the right growing conditions. The Bay Platinum Cookies side contributes the fuel note, the skunky earth depth, and the potency ceiling that keeps the sativa energy from being purely airy. The combination produced an 80/20 sativa that hits fast, stays clean, and tastes like exactly what it is named after — candy with enough fuel underneath to remind you it is cannabis. Four people shot footage of this strain. @blazehydro reviewed it on YouTube. Three others followed. When consumers reach for a camera before they finish the first bowl, that is a specific kind of endorsement that no product description produces. Watch those: @blazehydro THCa Review | Additional Footage | Another Review | YouTube Short The living soil cultivation is what keeps Candyland worth growing in 2026. Most commercially available Candyland is grown in synthetic nutrient programs that produce the potency and the visual but flatten the terpene complexity. The sweet candy note and the fuel depth that make the strain’s flavor profile distinctive are both terpene-dependent qualities — they require the full biochemical complexity that a living soil microbial ecosystem supports rather than just the NPK ratios that synthetic programs deliver. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Afghani Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Ramiya ordered at night. It arrived the next morning. She tried it and wrote: “Honestly one of the best strains I’ve ever had. The flavor is earthy, the smoke was clean, and the effects were exactly what I wanted (sleepy, relaxed, euphoric). Definitely sticking to this landrace strain. I’ve tried many THCa flowers, this has gotta be the freshest and most potent medicine I’ve had.” She is only buying from Sherlocks now. That is both a store endorsement and a strain review from someone who has tried enough THCa flower to have a reference point worth trusting. Afghani is the same pure Hindu Kush landrace that appears in the Afghani Living Soil Exotic AAA — the genetics that built the Western cannabis industry, the pure indica that appears in the lineage of OG Kush, Blueberry, Northern Lights, and virtually every major hybrid in the last forty years. This is the Indoor Special version. Same genetics, controlled indoor environment, a different price point for buyers who want the Afghani experience without the AAA premium. What indoor cultivation provides for Afghani specifically is humidity management. Pure indica landraces with the compact, dense bud structure that Hindu Kush genetics produce are susceptible to moisture retention in variable humidity environments — the density that makes the visual so striking is also what makes precise drying and curing essential. Indoor precision keeps the moisture gradient consistent from the surface of the bud to the core, which is what produces the clean smoke that Ramiya specifically noted. Harsh smoke in indica-dominant flower almost always traces back to improper drying or residual moisture in dense bud structure. This does not have that problem. The earthy hash character that Ramiya described as exactly what she wanted is the myrcene and caryophyllene combination in Afghani genetics — the same compounds that produce the classic hash aroma the original plant was cultivated for in the Hindu Kush mountains. Deep, spiced earth with pine and a subtle herbal warmth. The freshness she noticed is the terpene integrity that proper indoor drying and curing preserves. The pot

She tried it and wrote: “Honestly one of the best strains I’ve ever had. The flavor is earthy, the smoke was clean, and the effects were exactly what I wanted (sleepy, relaxed, euphoric). Definitely sticking to this landrace strain. I’ve tried many THCa flowers, this has gotta be the freshest and most potent medicine I’ve had.” She is only buying from Sherlocks now. That is both a store endorsement and a strain review from someone who has tried enough THCa flower to have a reference point worth trusting. Afghani is the same pure Hindu Kush landrace that appears in the Afghani Living Soil Exotic AAA — the genetics that built the Western cannabis industry, the pure indica that appears in the lineage of OG Kush, Blueberry, Northern Lights, and virtually every major hybrid in the last forty years. This is the Indoor Special version. Same genetics, controlled indoor environment, a different price point for buyers who want the Afghani experience without the AAA premium. What indoor cultivation provides for Afghani specifically is humidity management. Pure indica landraces with the compact, dense bud structure that Hindu Kush genetics produce are susceptible to moisture retention in variable humidity environments — the density that makes the visual so striking is also what makes precise drying and curing essential. Indoor precision keeps the moisture gradient consistent from the surface of the bud to the core, which is what produces the clean smoke that Ramiya specifically noted. Harsh smoke in indica-dominant flower almost always traces back to improper drying or residual moisture in dense bud structure. This does not have that problem. The earthy hash character that Ramiya described as exactly what she wanted is the myrcene and caryophyllene combination in Afghani genetics — the same compounds that produce the classic hash aroma the original plant was cultivated for in the Hindu Kush mountains. Deep, spiced earth with pine and a subtle herbal warmth. The freshness she noticed is the terpene integrity that proper indoor drying and curing preserves. The pot

Alien Tsunami Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA There is no entry for Alien Tsunami in the databases. No Leafly page. No Seedfinder listing. No breeder profile. This strain exists in one place — in the living soil beds of our new Southern Oregon micro farm partner — and now on our shelf. That’s not a gap in the data. That’s the point. Some of the best cannabis in the world doesn’t have a Wikipedia page. It has a farmer who has been watching it grow for years, taking notes no one else will ever read, and selecting for something that can’t be quantified on a lab report. Alien Tsunami is that strain. And what this farmer told us about growing it this run stopped us cold. From the Farmer — Notes on Alien Tsunami “This strain doesn’t grow — it arrives. What struck me most this run was the way Alien Tsunami handles stress. Every other plant in the room, when I’d do a heavy defoliation pass, would show a 36–48 hour recovery lag — you can read it in the leaves, a subtle drooping. Alien Tsunami showed zero lag. She didn’t flinch. She looked more vigorous the very next morning, like pruning her was the thing she’d been waiting for. I’ve started thinking of her as a strain with an almost accelerated biological memory — like she’s been genetically shaped by something that pruned her aggressively over generations and she rewired herself to thrive on it. The other thing — and I’ve never read this anywhere — is that her upper canopy colas and her lowermost popcorn buds smell completely different from each other on the same plant. The tops carry this electric, almost ozone-and-green-mango profile. But the lowers? Deep, slow, damp — like forest floor and overripe melon. Same plant, same soil, same light. Two completely different terpene stories depending on altitude within the canopy. I think light intensity is literally writing different chemical novels on the same genetic manuscript. Personal tasting note: First hit is almost aquatic — clean and weightless, like breathing near a cold river. Then it warms into something tropical and slightly metallic, like a copper bowl full of lychee. The transition between those two worlds is the whole experience.” –

Blue Nerds Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Blue Nerds is one of those strains that creates a problem for the people selling it. The visual is so immediately arresting — deep grape-shaped buds, purple and blue coloration running through dense forest green, trichomes so thick they catch light from across a room — that the first thing every customer does is reach for the jar. The second thing they do is smell it and realize the visual wasn’t even the point. Sweet blueberry candy opens immediately. Tart citrus builds underneath. Then Granny Smith apple arrives — sharp and bright and not at all what the name prepared you for — and suddenly you understand why Global Genetics LA introduced this at Spannabis 2024 to the response it received. This is a candy terpene profile built on Runtz and Zkittlez genetics, which means the sweetness has depth rather than just surface. It doesn’t smell like a candy aisle. It smells like the specific piece of candy you remember eating as a child that you’ve been trying to find again ever since. The living soil cultivation is doing specific work here that is worth understanding. Blue Nerds carries a strong tendency toward purple and blue anthocyanin expression, and anthocyanin development responds to temperature cycling in ways that living soil cultivation naturally facilitates. A living soil bed — because of the thermal mass of its organic matter and microbiology — holds temperature more consistently than synthetic media but produces more natural day-to-night temperature variation than controlled indoor environments. That variation is what triggers the deepest purple expression in this genetics. The Blue Nerds in a living soil bed purple more completely and more evenly across the canopy than the same genetics in coco or rockwool. The visual that makes people reach for the jar is not incidental. It is what living soil does to this plant specifically. Our grower noted something else in this run that we haven’t been able to stop thinking about. In the final two weeks of flower, the terpene profile on Blue Nerds shifted in a way that surprised them. Electric Kool Aid Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Tom Wolfe wrote The Electric Kool-Aid Acid Test in 1968 about Ken Kesey and the Merry Pranksters and the specific color that fluorescent paint and blacklight and San Francisco produced together. Periwinkle blue. Not purple. Not blue-purple. The specific shade that sits between them and catches light from across the room. The buds on this batch are that color. Purple Diesel x Cherry Pie — the GDP and Durban Poison genetics from the Cherry Pie side producing the anthocyanin expression, the diesel fuel lineage from Purple Diesel adding the gas depth, and the combination producing a visual that earns the name in a direct rather than metaphorical sense. Loyd H tried it and wrote one word: electrifying. Ekael N was honest — it did not look quite as colorful as the photo online, but the taste was incredible and it was the best he had tried from Sherlocks so far. That honesty is worth more than agreement would be. The color varies by batch and by how long ago it was harvested. The taste does not vary. The taste is what the genetics produce and what the indoor cultivation preserves. Purple Diesel contributes the hashy grape-lavender aroma, the diesel fuel note, and the uplifting sativa energy that keeps the experience moving rather than settling. Cherry Pie — Grand Daddy Purple x Durban Poison — adds the sweet cherry-berry character, the anthocyanin potential that produces the periwinkle visual, and enough indica ease to ground the Purple Diesel sativa without slowing it down. The combination is genuinely unusual in the way that strain names earned through association with cultural moments tend to be — weird, specific, and more coherent when you experience it than when you read the lineage. The indoor cultivation is what keeps the grape-cherry-diesel terpene combination intact through the full product life. Cherry Pie genetics carry linalool and myrcene that stabilize well under controlled conditions but fade quickly with temperature variation. Purple Diesel’s fuel character requires the same limonene and caryophyllene preservation that any diesel-forward genetics need from the post-harvest environment

MAC has a reputation problem. Not a quality problem — a reputation problem. Because MAC, short for Miracle Alien Cookies, is one of the most widely grown strains in the American cannabis market and most people have encountered a version that underdelivered. Rushed cures. Mediocre trichome development. The genetics exist but the expression doesn’t. The Frosted MAC phenotype is specifically selected to fix that. It is the MAC expression where the trichome production actually matches what the genetics promise — a silver-white frost across every bud surface so thick and uniform it looks almost artificial. This is our Light Assist tier. Greenhouse grown with real natural sunlight and supplemental lighting to extend the cycle and support terpene development. The price reflects the grow method. The genetics and the smoke quality do not. What we have noticed about Frosted MAC in light assist specifically — and this took us a few runs to fully understand — is that the natural sunlight spectrum does something to the citrus terpene expression that full indoor cannot replicate at this price point. The limonene in MAC under natural light reads differently than the same genetics under artificial spectrum only. Brighter. More fresh-squeezed orange than artificial citrus. The creamy vanilla underneath it stays. The diesel stays. But the citrus sits above everything with a clarity that is genuinely unusual for a light assist product. The grower who supplies this run has been selecting Frosted MAC phenotypes specifically for trichome density for three consecutive seasons. The current selection is the most visually striking of the three — every bud surface covered in amber-tipped trichomes that catch light from across a room. For buyers who want MAC the way MAC is supposed to look, this is the one. Lemon Custard Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA The lemon dessert category has been one of the fastest-growing segments of the current cannabis market, and most of it lands in one of two directions: either lemon-forward with a generic sweet background, or dessert-forward with a lemon note that disappears quickly. Lemon Custard is the version that holds both simultaneously rather than sacrificing one for the other — the custard character, the warm egg-and-vanilla depth that actual custard produces, sitting beneath a bright lemon peel top note that remains specific and vivid rather than fading into generic citrus. Lemon Custard’s lineage traces to a Lemon Tree or Lemon Skunk-adjacent parent crossed with a Cookies-family or Gelato-family dessert contributor — the specific pairing that multiple breeders have converged on independently because it is the combination most likely to produce the custard character rather than just lemon-sweet or just creamy-dessert. The Lemon Tree heritage carries a specific limonene-plus-myrcene combination that produces the bright-and-grounded citrus quality — not sharp and clean like pure limonene, but warm and slightly earthy in a way that reads as the lemon in a baked custard rather than fresh-squeezed juice. The Cookies or Gelato contribution adds the vanilla and cream base that the custard name requires. What makes Lemon Custard worth growing in living soil specifically is the myrcene component. The warm, earthy depth that distinguishes the lemon custard character from generic lemon sweetness comes from the myrcene expression in the Lemon Tree-adjacent genetics — and myrcene, as documented across multiple strains in this program, develops more completely in living soil environments where the soil biology is supporting the full secondary metabolite expression rather than just the dominant limonene fraction. The citrus is present in any cultivation environment. The custard warmth that justifies the name is what the living soil is producing. Maui Wowie Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Michael got his order in about five days, tried the Maui Wowie alongside the White Widow, and was not let down compared to other vendors he had tried online. That review matters specifically because Michael named the strain — he was not reviewing the store in general or a different product, he was reviewing Maui Wowie specifically and decided it delivered. Maui Wowie has been in circulation since the 1970s. Hawaiian sativa landrace genetics, developed on the islands before most of the American cannabis market existed, selected over decades for the specific tropical fruit and citrus terpene profile and the clear, energetic, altitude-friendly high that became one of the most widely referenced cannabis experiences in the country. It has been imitated, diluted, and misrepresented on menus more than almost any other classic sativa. When it is the real genetics and it is grown correctly, the pineapple and mango note is specific and immediate — not tropical-adjacent, not citrus-forward with fruit described as tropical, but the actual Hawaiian sativa character that the original cultivars produced. Stephanie tried this batch and described a light fresh tropical smell and taste, then a hit of candy, then mint — ending in what she called eventual nirvana via a progression through calm, giggles, deep peace, and sustained tranquility throughout the body. That three-note terpene progression from tropical to candy to mint is the terpinolene expression from the Hawaiian genetics doing exactly what it evolved to do when it is given the cultivation conditions to develop fully. The light assist greenhouse is the correct environment for Maui Wowie for a reason that goes beyond the general light-assist-for-sativa explanation. Hawaiian landrace genetics evolved at altitude in the tropics — high UV exposure, warm days, cool nights, the full solar spectrum without moderation. These genetics do not respond to artificial-only spectrum the way continental sativa genetics do. They were bred for sun and they perform best when sun is part of the equation. The UV component of the greenhouse environment triggers terpinolene and ocime

Pure Michigan Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA ThugPug Genetics and 3rd Coast Genetics are both based in Michigan. When they collaborated on Pure Michigan they were not just naming a strain after geography — they were making a claim about what Michigan cannabis breeding had become by the time this cross was developed. Oreoz crossed with Mendo Breath F2. Oreoz itself a Cookies N Cream x Secret Weapon cross with the cookie-and-cream dessert depth and the potency ceiling that made it one of the most sought-after Cookies-adjacent genetics of the last decade. Mendo Breath F2 — the stabilized second-generation selection that ThugPug had already used in Peanut Butter Breath — contributing the heavy frost, the earthy vanilla-caramel depth, and the deeply relaxing indica body effect that Mendo Breath genetics consistently deliver. The combination produced a strain that looked unlike most of what was on the market and tasted more complex than the visual suggested it would. The visual is the first thing. Dense, heavily frosted buds that one reviewer described as a storm cloud dipped in diamonds — an overstatement that lands correctly because the trichome density on Pure Michigan at full development is genuinely unusual. The frost is not distributed evenly across the surface in the way that most high-THC genetics produce it. It accumulates in layers, the older trichomes slightly amber at the base and the newer development building on top in clear crystal. The effect of looking at a well-grown Pure Michigan bud in direct light is specific and immediately memorable. The aroma is where the Michigan claim lands. Chocolate, coffee, nutty spice, and creamy vanilla with hints of citrus and diesel depending on the cut and cure. Purple Dream Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Two strains that need no introduction crossed into one that earns its own name. Granddaddy Purple is Ken Estes’s Purple Urkle x Big Bud cross from 2003 — one of the most visually striking and instantly recognizable indica expressions in American cannabis history, the deep purple-and-blue buds and grape candy aroma that became the visual reference for what premium indica looks like in a jar. Blue Dream is the Santa Cruz hybrid of DJ Short Blueberry and Super Silver Haze that became the most widely available sativa-dominant strain in California dispensaries for most of the 2010s — clear-headed, functional, berry and citrus sweet, the strain that converted more indica-only consumers to sativa than anything else in the modern market. Purple Dream takes the GDP grape sweetness and the Blue Dream cerebral clarity and runs them together. The result is described accurately in the meta description: calm without couch-lock. The GDP indica body ease arrives and stays, but the Blue Dream Haze genetics keep the headspace clear and present rather than pulling it down with the body. The grape and berry terpene profiles from both parents layer into something more complex than either delivers independently — the GDP linalool and the Blue Dream’s terpinolene sit in the same profile at the same time and the combination reads as purple berry and sweet fruit with a citrus note from the Haze genetics that keeps it from being purely dessert. The indoor cultivation handles the GDP genetics correctly — Granddaddy Purple’s dense, moisture-retentive bud structure needs humidity management that indoor cultivation provides consistently. The deep purple and blue coloration that makes GDP crosses visually distinctive develops under controlled temperature variation, and indoor environments provide that variation in a predictable way rather than leaving it to ambient weather conditions. The visual on Purple Dream reflects the GDP anthocyanin genetics expressing correctly in a well-managed indoor environment. Watch the Purple Dream review on YouTube . Street Tarts Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Purple City Genetics built Street Tarts from Guava Tart and Street Guru, and the cross landed in a specific territory between tropical fruit candy and gas-forward pastry that most strains named after confectionery never actually reach. Guava Tart brings the guava funk and tropical tartness. Street Guru brings the street-level gas depth and the urban edge that the name implies. Together they produce something that is genuinely tart in the way fruit candy is tart rather than the way generic “candy” strains approximate it — the citrus and tropical notes have an actual sour bite before the sweetness resolves. The visual is what consumers consistently mention first. Glittering purple buds drenched in resinous trichomes, with a trichome architecture dense enough to reflect light. The purple coloration develops from the genetics rather than temperature stress — it is an expression of the anthocyanin compounds in the Guava Tart genetics rather than a manipulation of the environment to force color. That distinction matters in living soil cultivation: the color is the plant’s own response to the genetics under conditions that support full secondary metabolite expression. The terpene profile runs tropical, gas, and pastry simultaneously — a nose that opens with guava and tropical citrus tartness, then shifts to the Street Guru gas depth, then settles on something warm and slightly doughy underneath. That progression is what earns the “tarts” reference: a candy that opens sweet-tart and resolves to something with body. Indica-leaning hybrid. Cerebral euphoria arriving first, body weight building. This is from our private Northern California small-batch program — limited quantity, grown in living soil, not a rotating catalog item. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Super Runtz Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Gelato 33 x Zkittlez is the cross. Gelato 33 — the Bay Area selection from Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC that Sherbinski developed into one of the most imitated genetics of the last decade — brings the creamy ice cream sweetness, the dense trichome architecture, the euphoric balanced body ease, and the vanilla and cream depth that grounds the experience. Zkittlez, from 3rd Gen Family and Terp Hogz, brings the tropical candy fruit, the multi-layer brightness, and the uplifting social energy that keeps the Gelato 33 indica character from being purely sedative. The Super designation is what breeders use when a specific phenotype expresses both parent contributions at unusual intensity simultaneously — more fruit than standard Runtz, more cream than standard Zkittlez, the combination amplified rather than averaged. Jesse T found Sherlocks in a THCa Google search and the bag was loud when he popped it open. The smell was not muted like some internet THCa flower. That observation — loud, not muted — is the specific thing that the Indoor Special tier exists to deliver and the specific thing that this cross produces when the cultivation and post-harvest protocol are done correctly. The Indoor Special cultivation is the right environment for Super Runtz because Gelato 33 x Zkittlez genetics require temperature precision that outdoor and greenhouse cultivation cannot consistently provide. The vanilla and cream character from the Gelato 33 side is produced by a linalool and myrcene combination that stabilizes most completely under controlled temperatures during both flowering and cure. The tropical fruit brightness from the Zkittlez side requires the same limonene preservation that every citrus-adjacent terpene profile requires — controlled drying, low temperature, slow stabilization. Indoor cultivation handles both simultaneously. What Jesse T found loud in the bag is the result of that temperature management applied to genetics that specifically reward it. Two fruit-forward indicas, both known for sweetness and relaxation, combined into a strain that tastes like watermelon candy. And it does. The nose on Watermelon Z is immediately and unmistakably watermelon — not an approximation of watermelon, not watermelon-adjacent, but the specific candy-sweet, slightly musky, ripe-fruit smell that makes you reach for a second sniff before you have finished processing the first one. _*]:min-w-0 gap-3"> What makes Watermelon Z more interesting than its straightforward description suggests is the Zkittlez contribution. Zkittlez genetics carry a terpene architecture built around multiple distinct fruit notes layered on top of each other, which means the watermelon note in this cross sits above a tropical fruit depth that keeps the profile from being one-dimensional. There is mango and citrus underneath the watermelon. There is a slight earthy spice from the OG lineage running beneath that. The candy note is the loudest thing in the jar but it is not the only thing. _*]:min-w-0 gap-3"> The light assist cultivation is doing specific work here worth understanding. Watermelon Z’s fruit terpene expression — specifically the compounds responsible for the melon-candy character — develops most fully under conditions that include real UV light exposure. Artificial spectrum can replicate most of what natural light does to cannabis, but the UV component of direct sunlight triggers secondary metabolite production in ways that full indoor grows cannot match at comparable cost. The Watermelon OG genetics carry a strong response to UV exposure — the trichome development, the anthocyanin expression, and the fruit terpene loudness all respond to real sunlight in ways that show up clearly in this crop. The greenhouse environment provides that UV exposure consistently without the environmental variability of full outdoor cultivation. For a strain whose primary appeal is its terpene character, the grow method is not incidental. It is part of why the watermelon actually smells like watermelon. _*]:

Yum Berry Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Also known as: Blueberry Yum Yum Blueberry Yum Yum has a name that predates the strain. Ludacris released the song in 2001, named after the specific sweet blueberry candy character that DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce when they are grown correctly — a flavor reference so specific and so recognizable that it became cultural vocabulary before anyone formalized it as a strain name. The strain named itself after the song, or the song named itself after the flavor, depending on which version of the story you prefer. Either way, when the genetics actually deliver on the name, the reference makes immediate sense. Blueberry x Durban Poison is a cross we carry in two expressions — Bali Berry and Yum Berry — because the same genetic combination produces meaningfully different phenotype expressions depending on which parent’s character dominates. Bali Berry leans toward the Durban Poison’s tropical-island brightness — the terpinolene and ocimene expression that produces the lychee-mango-adjacent complexity that distinguishes the strain from standard berry crosses. Yum Berry leans toward the Blueberry side — the linalool-forward DJ Short expression that produces the specific sweet blueberry candy note the song and the strain are both named after. Same genetics, different phenotype selection, genuinely different terpene experience. The Yum Berry phenotype was selected specifically for the Blueberry Yum Yum character — the concentrated, slightly artificial-sweet blueberry that the linalool-dominant Blueberry expression produces at its most extreme. This is not fresh blueberry or blueberry jam. It is the specific candy version of blueberry that appears in the Blueberry genetics when the linalool accumulation reaches a certain threshold. Thomas Watson described a happy, euphoric high that tastes great and looks great. That combination — the candy-sweet terpene profile producing a euphoric balanced experience — is exactly what the Blueberry Yum Yum phenotype selection was designed to deliver. The living soil cultivation does specific work with the DJ Short Blueberry genetics that is worth understanding.
